rationale: C02 is an exceptionally close drafting template: it uses the same list of tax returns, the same Eighty-third Congress limitation, the same Government Operations committee function, the identical economy-and-efficiency purpose, the same Treasury-decision condition, and the same Federal Register effectiveness clause. The child primarily adapts C02 from the Senate committee to the corresponding House committee and changes the covered period formulation. C18 is a strong earlier antecedent for the same investigative-purpose language, while C16 closely shares the general tax-return inspection machinery and contemporaneous period language.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for any period to and including 1952
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1952, inclusive
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive six-category enumeration is retained, with only the temporal formulation changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Committee on Government Operations, House of Representatives, or any duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall, during the Eighty-third Congress, be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Government Operations or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof
shared_material.explanation: The operative authorization is nearly verbatim, adapted from the Senate committee to its House counterpart.

shared_material.child_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.parent_excerpt: in connection with its studies of the operation of Government activities at all levels with a view to determining its economy and efficiency
shared_material.explanation: This substantive statement of investigative purpose is identical.

shared_material.child_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision1 relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date. This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision1 relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date. This Executive order shall be effective upon its filing for publication in the Federal Register.
